svg.title: Failure taxonomy
svg.desc: A block diagram with four columns, one per failure type: tag 1 action, tag 2 sensor, tag 3 plan, tag 4 world drift. Under each type is the signal that detects it: an action failure, the skill returns a failure reason; a sensor failure, a status field, an impossible value or silence; a plan failure, the plan fails a check before it runs; world drift, a fresh observation differs from the expected state. The bottom row says where recovery starts: action failures in the behavior tree (retry, fallback); sensor failures in a check before the value is used; plan failures and world drift in the planner or agent (a new plan). Two dashed boxes on top are new sources of failure from AI components: VLM output feeds the sensor column, LLM output feeds the plan column.
